Fitness tends to come back faster than tendons, bone and cartilage adapt, so the body can feel ready before it really is. That is why aches often show up around week four.

What can help: start at about half what you think you can do, add roughly 10% a week, do two short strength sessions weekly, and keep sessions regular rather than in big bursts. Treat a lingering niggle as a sign to ease back a little.

What can help: set saddle height so the knee is moderately bent at the bottom of the stroke, check saddle fore-aft position and cleat alignment, spin lighter gears at a higher cadence, build distance gradually, and add single-leg strength work.
